name: CHN Energy Changyuan Electric Power Co.,Ltd.
summary: CHN Energy Changyuan Electric Power Co.,Ltd. produces and sells electricity and heat in China. It generates electricity through thermal, photovoltaic, hydro, wind, and biomass sources, as well as provides technical and training services. The company was formerly known as Guodian Changyuan Electric Power Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CHN Energy Changyuan Electric Power Co.,Ltd. in August 2021. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Wuhan, China. CHN Energy Changyuan Electric Power Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Chnenergy Investment Group Co.,LTD.
